hook: A genetic study of over 1.2 million people finds 343 pain-linked regions, 92 of them new.
summary: Meta-analysis of three biobanks covering 1,235,695 European-ancestry people found 343 independent loci for multidimensional pain, plus sex-specific loci and 490 prioritized genes. Mendelian randomization suggested causal links to psychiatric and substance use disorders and C-reactive protein. The data are European-ancestry only and the female sample is much smaller than the male one.
title: Gene discovery and pleiotropic architecture of multidimensional pain in a genome-wide association study of >1.2 million individuals.
